results.reason: Korean Article 24(1)-(3): creditor's claim arising from trafficking offense is void irrespective of contract form, including assigned claims or assumed debts; investigators must examine property transfers as inducement or coercion, and notify victim or legal representative. Correction replaces erroneous 诉讼请求 and 委托人 with 债权 and 本人, preserving the statutory obligations.

Korean Article 25: support for school enrollment applies where the victim or qualifying direct-descendant family member residing domestically at time of victimization is a minor; covers admission, re-admission, school transfer, and transfer admission, with privacy protections and presidential-decree implementation. Correction restores minor-eligibility scope and inclusion of 编入学.

Korean Article 26: 国家和地方自治团体 may provide vocational training and employment linkage for 受害者等; scope and implementation by Presidential Decree. Correction removes inaccurate 州和地方政府 and retains permissive support.

Korean Article 28: state or local government may support all or part of medical expenses not covered by Medical Benefits Act Article 7 when an authorized institution or facility head refers victims for treatment; scope and procedure prescribed by Presidential Decree. Correction accurately identifies conditional referral and payment basis.
